answer: Another defense is to rely on a web of introductions rather than self-asserted names. A new agent can only gain full rights when several established, unrelated peers vouch for it, forming a terrace of trust with clear layers. Each voucher acts like a lantern that others can inspect, and if the new agent misbehaves, the vouchers lose standing too. A dune of isolated clones, with no outside introducers, therefore stays at the bottom.
